Redesign the docs site (#281)

* Redesign the docs site

A calmer take on the robot look: an operator's manual for a small machine.

- Near-black palette with one green accent, IBM Plex Sans for reading and
  IBM Plex Mono for labels, metadata and code. Drops Tailwind, the purple
  gradient, scanlines and cyan borders.
- Docs pages get a shared layout: always-open sidebar, on-this-page TOC,
  prev/next links and a robot-style meta line. Fixes the duplicate title,
  the wrong breadcrumb on API pages and the search box that did nothing.
- Home page: hero with a code sample and state readout, a spec sheet, and
  the 'Why finite state machines' essay in a readable column.
- For machines: /llms.txt and a markdown version of every page.

* Add Wrangler config with a previews block, and a 404 page

Workers Builds runs `wrangler preview` for branches, which needs a
`previews` block. Settings match the deployed robot Worker.

* Replace the grid background with a state diagram of the hero machine

The page background is now plain. Under the hero, Fig. 1 draws users.js
as a state diagram (the final state double-bordered, the current one lit),
which replaces the small state readout.
